scenes.text: Claude built it in four phases, one prompt each. Every piece sits on a month calendar in its channel color, and nothing is scheduled until an editor who didn't write it approves it.

But the useful part is what broke. Sign-in told strangers to ask an editor to add them, but no screen managed people. And one part of the spec let editors withdraw any piece, while another said owner only.

CoSchedule Starter is twenty-nine dollars a month for one user, and campaigns need the Suite plan. If your team just needs the plan, you mostly need the calendar, the approval step, and the reminders.
